# Agent HQ

> Open-source, mobile-first AI agent harness. HQ lives on an Android phone (the vault, tasks, chat, inbox and supervisor); laptops, desktops and servers join it with a QR code and reach it directly over an encrypted peer-to-peer link (iroh), with no Tailscale, WireGuard or VPN. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex run on those machines and the phone supervises them. HQ can also run on its own on a laptop or a VPS. One Rust binary, a markdown vault you can open.

- [Install guide](https://agent-hq.online/install/): curl script (Linux x86_64 and ARM, macOS on Apple Silicon and Intel), Homebrew, npx, Docker and server setup
- [Architecture](https://agent-hq.online/architecture/): how the daemon, vault, relays and MCP gateway fit together
- [Windows](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq/blob/main/docs/WINDOWS.md): Full HQ runs inside WSL2 (Ubuntu) with coding agents; HQ Lite is a native, no-admin edition for work computers (web app, tasks, notes, MCP). Install: `irm https://agent-hq.online/install.ps1 | iex`
- [Add a machine that runs coding agents](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq/blob/main/docs/JOIN_A_MACHINE.md): `hq host join`, `hq host add`, `hq host check`, for macOS, Linux and WSL2
- [HQ on an Android phone](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq/blob/main/docs/HQ_MOBILE.md): the home base. Early access: you build the APK yourself (`apps/android`) for now; keep the phone on a charger, since a sleeping, unplugged phone is not yet shown to answer in time
- [macOS desktop app](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq/blob/main/docs/DESKTOP.md): a small Tauri app that starts the local host, pairs devices and connects Claude. Build it yourself; it is unsigned and has no updater
- [Claude through your laptop](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq/blob/main/docs/plans/native-bridge-sprint.md): Claude Code (`http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp` over the paired link), Claude Desktop (`hq mcp-serve --remote <name>`) and Claude Code Remote Control reach HQ while the laptop is on. A public claude.ai connector (docs/CLAUDE_CONNECTOR.md) needs a public HTTPS machine and is not the default
- [QR pairing](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq/blob/main/docs/PAIRING.md): pair the phone with a laptop, desktop or server with a QR code and six digits, then reach each other by key over iroh; named services and local forwards carry the web app, HQ's tools and the coding-agent host. In every Linux and macOS build; Windows pairs from WSL2
- [hq edge](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq/blob/main/docs/EDGE.md): a public forwarder you run yourself so a device behind NAT, such as a phone on mobile data, can answer HTTPS on a name you own. Off by default; there is no project-run edge
- [hq net](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq/blob/main/docs/PRIVATE_NETWORK.md): optional, advanced. A self-hosted WireGuard network between an HQ server and your devices; not needed to connect your own machines. Release builds do not include the root applier yet
- [Backup and restore](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq/blob/main/docs/BACKUP.md): `hq backup` writes one encrypted file with your notes, a copy of the database and, optionally, your config; `hq restore` brings it back
- [Compare](https://agent-hq.online/compare/): Agent HQ next to OpenClaw and Hermes Agent
- [Security](https://agent-hq.online/security/): sandbox, signed releases, reporting a vulnerability
- [Source code](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq): repository, issues and changelog
- [Agent setup guide](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq/blob/main/AGENTS-SETUP.md): a file you can hand to your own AI agent so it installs HQ for you
